The authoritative text of the Indian Constitution in Hindi was authorized to be published by which of the following constitutional amendments? (a) 57th Amendment, 1987 (b) 58th Amendment, 1987 (c) 59th Amendment, 1988 (d) 60th Amendment, 1988 U.P.R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) 2016 Ans. (b) Under 58th Amendment Act, 1987, the authoritative text of the Indian Constitution in Hindi was authorized to be published as there has been a general demand for the publication of the authoritative text of the Constitution in Hindi incorporating therein all the subsequent amendments. 32. (Mains) 2014 Ans. (a) 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 reduced the age for Right to Vote from 21 to 18 years. It came into force on March 28, 1989. 33.
